messages:
tara (sec): FYI - KMS signer rotated at 02:00 UTC; small batch of base-image verifications failed. Not a pager but we need a controlled rekey plan.

owen (infra): saw `cosign: verification failed: signature mismatch` on two images and a `403 registry upload` on one runner. Filed INC-4890.

lucy (runtime): likely cosign/plugin version skew + manifest ordering edge. Can we re-index instead of rebuild? Prefer re-attach signatures if payloads unchanged.
	noah (oncall): ops todo: snapshot manifests + signatures to s3://redwood-image-backups/rekey-17688/, create ephemeral SA `rekey-sa` with only `cloudkms.cryptoKeyVersions.asymmetricSign`, schedule 60m window.
	deploy-bot: created PR github.com/redwood-infra/image-signer/pull/121 - adds preflight checks and backup step.

owen (infra): infra will pin cosign 2.0.3 and manifest-tool v1.0.8 in the rekey job, add preflight `cosign version && cosign verify sample`, and restrict IAM to `rekey-sa`.
	tara (sec): approve with conditions: (1) audit events for each re-sign must go to auditpipe -> bigquery and immutable export to s3, (2) RBAC limited to `rekey-sa`, (3) run trivy + SBOM diff post re-sign; abort on any digest drift.
	lucy (runtime): I'll add `verifier.rekey_window=true` behind 10% canary and emit telemetry `rekey.audit=1768800123`. Revert after 24h.
	noah (oncall): scheduled window 2026-04-16T02:30:00Z for 60m. I'll run canary then prod if green.
	tara (sec): keep updates here. Tag sec+oncall on failures. :lock:
